name: Red Petal Bastion
summary: Red Petal Bastion is a group dungeon in northeast Glenumbra. It is one of two dungeons available with the Waking Flame DLC, the other being the Dread Cellar. It is inhabited by the Knights of the Silver Rose, an order dedicated to ridding the world of Daedric corruption. They have amassed a vast collection of Daedric artifacts, which have corrupted the knights. Now, the order's strongest warriors wield the relics they once sought to lock away. Beetles, Centipedes and Rats are found in numbers within.
notes: Some strings originally referred to this dungeon as Rose Petal Bastion before being changed in a patch.
